body.notes: Icon-in-disc ratio fix queued: 1236-1251, 17 cards on 16 posts (12 steps, 5 icons). Operator: 'the image should cover the whole circle frame'. The steps/icons layouts drew the icon at ~47% of the disc; ICON_IN_DISC=0.65 in layouts.mjs now derives it from the disc, matching the list layout's 30px-in-46px circle (58 cards, never questioned). Rendered 0.75 as a check and it reads cramped: ceiling is ~0.70 since the inscribed square is 70.7% of a circle. Image swap only, same alt byte for byte, same position, all 17 introduced:[]. 3803's card grew 630->732px because bigger icons change the measured content extent, which is why the whole figure is rewritten rather than just the src. 2 of 17 uploads collided and came back as -r2-1.webp; use the response url verbatim, and simpatch then reports 'missing' for out/<served name> which is the check confused by the rename, not a bad patch. NOTE: this deliberately breaks the IWC pixel-identity rule - IWC steps/icons are still at 47% and that is a separate decision, do not restore.
